vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: meta-ads-paid-ads
Version: 1.1.0

The skill bundle contains purely informational content and instructional guidelines for an AI agent to assist with Meta (Facebook/Instagram) Ads management. There is no executable code, no network activity, and no evidence of malicious prompt injection or data exfiltration across the _meta.json and SKILL.md files.

llm.summary: This is an instruction-only guidance skill for Meta (Facebook/Instagram) Ads and its declared requirements and behavior are consistent with that purpose.

dimensions.detail: The name and description match the content of SKILL.md: campaign structure, targeting, creative, optimization and tracking guidance. The skill does not request unrelated credentials, binaries, or system access.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md contains only high-level best practices and checklists. It does not instruct the agent to read local files, access environment variables, call external endpoints, or collect credentials. Mentions of Pixel and Conversions API are contextual (recommendations), not operational instructions to transmit data or fetch keys.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec and no code files — lowest-risk, instruction-only skill. Nothing is downloaded or written to disk during install.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares no required environment variables, credentials, or config paths. That is proportionate for a guidance-only skill.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and the skill does not request elevated or persistent privileges. Model invocation is allowed (default) which is normal for skills; there are no additional privilege requests.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill is a text-only playbook for Meta Ads and appears coherent and low-risk. Before installing, understand that it only provides recommendations — it will not configure your accounts or access your Meta/advertising credentials. If a future version asks for API keys, tokens, or instructs the agent to paste secrets or perform account actions, treat that as a red flag and review what exact access is being requested. Always avoid pasting account credentials into chat and cross-check implementation steps (Pixel / Conversions API wiring) against official Meta documentation or your engineering team before applying changes to production.
